description: Mapeamento Trecho de Drenagem do Estado Bahia. Vetor 1:50.000 – 2019 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). A classe Trecho de drenagem foi gerada a partir do Mapeamento da cobertura vegetal e extração de informações planimétricas dos Biomas Cerrado, Caatinga e Mata Atlântica do estado da Bahia (INEMA, 2019). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are trecho drenagem, hidrografia, rios, recursos hídricos, environment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
